title: Administrative Law I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same even where such decision is null and void."
The situation is the same even where such decision is null and void.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a feature of modern governments principally because of government's a c t i v e intervention i n socio-economic, e d u c a t i o n a l , p o l i t i c a l a n d welfarist needs of citizens."

Delegated legislation is a feature of modern governments principally because of government's a c t i v e intervention i n socio-economic, e d u c a t i o n a l , p o l i t i c a l a n d welfarist needs of citizens.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an affirmative governmental policies geared towards giving a sense of belonging to every federating State (and, by extension, every citizen) in the administration of the country."
Federal character is an affirmative governmental policies geared towards giving a sense of belonging to every federating State (and, by extension, every citizen) in the administration of the country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to agreeing or disagreeing with one governmental policy or another."
Nigerians are used to agreeing or disagreeing with one governmental policy or another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be a sound basis for administrative efficiency and it does not by itself amount to abdication of power if restored to within proper limits."
Delegation is considered to be a sound basis for administrative efficiency and it does not by itself amount to abdication of power if restored to within proper limits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of notifying the ignorant of a policy, measure, decision, etc."
Publication is a means of notifying the ignorant of a policy, measure, decision, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the freedoms, liberties, immunities or benefits which are inherent in human beings in a civil society."
Human rights are the freedoms, liberties, immunities or benefits which are inherent in human beings in a civil society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a medium for the people to participate in the governance of their affairs."
Consultation is a medium for the people to participate in the governance of their affairs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more important when we realize that Nigeria is a country that has been crippled and still being crippled by endemic corruption."
The tool is the more important when we realize that Nigeria is a country that has been crippled and still being crippled by endemic corruption.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a doctrine that insists on the supremacy of law over the supremacy of man."
Rule of law is a doctrine that insists on the supremacy of law over the supremacy of man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the arm of government charged with the responsibility of making laws for the peace, order and good government of a State."
The legislature or parliament is the arm of government charged with the responsibility of making laws for the peace, order and good government of a State.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the other side must be heard."
Audi alteram partem means that the other side must be heard.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of bringing the decision, rule, regulation, policy of the administrative agency to the knowledge of the stakeholders or the general public, as the case may be."

Publication of rules and decisions is the act of bringing the decision, rule, regulation, policy of the administrative agency to the knowledge of the stakeholders or the general public, as the case may be.
fib: ______ means no judge can be a judge in his matter.
Nemo judex in causa sus
Nemo judex in causa sus means no judge can be a judge in his matter.
______ are the constitutional controls where separate branches of government have limiting power over each other so that no branch will become supreme.
Checks and balances
Checks and balances are the constitutional controls where separate branches of government have limiting power over each other so that no branch will become supreme.
______ is the branch of law regulating the relationship between the citizen and the State.
Public law
Public law is the branch of law regulating the relationship between the citizen and the State.
______ is the primacy regulator of basic social relations.
constitution
The constitution is the primacy regulator of basic social relations.
______ is the creation and promulgation of a general rule of conduct without reference to particular cases.
legislative act
A legislative act is the creation and promulgation of a general rule of conduct without reference to particular cases.
______ is the body before which ministers are called upon to account, and without the confidence of which they cannot continue.
Parliament
Parliament is the body before which ministers are called upon to account, and without the confidence of which they cannot continue.
______ is a public law category in the sense that it deals with the intercourse between governmental institutions on the one hand and private individuals or corporations on the other.
Administrative law
Administrative law is a public law category in the sense that it deals with the intercourse between governmental institutions on the one hand and private individuals or corporations on the other.
______ is one of the pillars upon which true democracy and good governance is established upon.
doctrine of Rule of Law
The doctrine of Rule of Law is one of the pillars upon which true democracy and good governance is established upon.
______ means that parliament can, if it chooses, legislate contrary to fundamental principles of human rights.
Parliamentary sovereignty
Parliamentary sovereignty means that parliament can, if it chooses, legislate contrary to fundamental principles of human rights.
______ is a concept that rejects the rule of man but prefers the management of the affairs of men and things by institutions established in accordance with law.
Constitutional supremacy
Constitutional supremacy is a concept that rejects the rule of man but prefers the management of the affairs of men and things by institutions established in accordance with law.
______ means that everything must be done in accordance with the law.
Rule of law primarily
Rule of law primarily means that everything must be done in accordance with the law.
______ is the most competent body to control administrative agencies.
executive
The executive is the most competent body to control administrative agencies.
______ are the most important and most impactful on the man in the street.
agency
agency are the most important and most impactful on the man in the street.
